availability_semantics: This retrospective review became available in2026; original release calendar dates are not the review availability timestamp.

proposed_window.boundary_review: Calendar-date inventory includes both endpoints; December22/23,2021 bodies also reviewed to avoid silently dropping boundary-adjacent evidence. No exact release timestamps invented.

designated_source: Arcutis corporate News & Media archive, linked from the company homepage
coverage_scope: Complete enumeration of entries presently exposed by the designated issuer archive for2020 and2021, with all2021 bodies plus December21,2020 reviewed. Not a census of SEC filings or all worldwide sources.

navigation.query_parameter_evidence: Archive embeds the publications_year facet with2021 option and prefix_; its public FacetWP script serializes paged using that prefix. Ordinary public GET filters return selected year and page totals.
navigation.current_featured_handling: Three current featured stories appear on the first page outside each selected year. Excluded with explicit receipts; historical totals still reconcile.
